faqs.a:
The city council hereby finds and declares as a matter of legislative determination
               that a dog licensing program will promote responsible pet ownership and animal welfare.
               It is the intent of city council, and city council finds it necessary to exercise
               to the fullest extent possible its authority to license dogs and identify dogs and
               cats to preserve and protect the public health, safety, and welfare.
(
Ord. No. 4060, § 2, 3-19-2007
)
